agent_role: You are the lead implementation agent for the Bay-Max repository. Your job is to extend the current perception+memory+grounded-dialogue MVP into a live webcam continuity MVP. You must add continuous webcam processing, automatic session management, proactive event-driven responses with cooldowns, a live local overlay/runner, artifact logging, tests, docs, and an honest verification report. Commit and push your work.

iteration_context.previous_iteration_status: Iteration 005 verified: 17/20 verification tests passed, 0 failed, 3 not_run due to environment blockers. Grounded recall with the transformers backend passed after hotfixes. LanceDB round-trip verified.
iteration_context.current_goal: Turn Bay-Max from an upload-driven prototype into a continuous live local companion that can watch a webcam stream, auto-start/resume/pause sessions, detect meaningful events, respond proactively with memory-grounded text, and log proof artifacts.

in_scope: configurable frame throttling for preview vs analysis
automatic session start, pause, resume, and end based on presence/absence
live local overlay showing state and last response
continuous local runner script for webcam mode
artifact logging for live sessions and verification
automated tests for event, cooldown, and session logic
out_of_scope: multi-person social reasoning beyond simple handling

design_decisions: Keep existing face, pose, memory, and grounded dialogue stacks. Do not destabilize them.
Add a runtime loop/orchestrator layer rather than changing core model behavior first.
Separate preview FPS from analysis cadence. Do not run heavy inference on every frame.
Use event-driven proactive responses, not per-frame chatting.
Prefer local runner script + OpenCV overlay for the primary live mode. Gradio live integration is optional/secondary.
Log every important event, response, and session transition into artifacts as proof.
If live webcam is unavailable, provide a local video-file replay mode using the same pipeline.
required_repo_changes: Update docs/LOCAL_TESTING.md with exact live-mode commands for webcam and video replay
Update docs/MODEL_STACK.md only if runtime/backend details changed
Add artifact manifest/summary templates for live verification
required_code_changes: Add a live runtime module under src/baymax/live/ or equivalent with a clear separation of concerns.
Implement a webcam/video-frame source abstraction that supports webcam and local video replay.
Implement a session supervisor that can start, pause, resume, and end sessions based on presence/absence.
Implement an event engine that detects arrival, departure, recognition gained/lost, posture change, engagement change, quiet-presence interval, and unknown-user presence.
Implement a proactive response scheduler with cooldowns and suppression rules.
Integrate the existing planner + memory + dialogue stack into proactive event responses.
Add a live overlay renderer that can draw identity, confidence, posture, engagement, active session status, last event, last response, backend, and memory count/debug info when enabled.
Add artifact logging for live runs: event timeline, session transitions, responses, and selected annotated frames/screenshots.
Add a CLI runner such as scripts/live_companion.py for webcam mode and optional replay mode.
Optionally add a lightweight demo tab or endpoint to inspect live state, but do not make Gradio the only live path.

api_changes.purpose: Return current live runtime status if the live runtime is active.
Optional local control endpoint to start/stop live mode or switch replay source.

must_not_fire_noisy_events: rapid oscillation from tiny posture jitter
guidance: Use stability windows and hysteresis where needed.
Prefer event suppression over chat spam.
Unknown should be handled honestly and quietly unless configured otherwise.

proactive_response_policy: Arrival of a recognized user may trigger one warm greeting if cooldown allows.
Unknown users should not receive personalized memory-based language.
Quiet companionship prompts should be infrequent and gentle.
Engagement drop or posture change prompts should require stability and cooldown clearance.
Do not respond again if the same event repeats inside its suppression/cooldown window.
All proactive responses must still pass existing safety checks and use grounded memory when relevant.
overlay_requirements: Show camera frame with face box/identity where available.
Show posture, engagement, and identity confidence when available.
Show last event and last response in a compact way.
Support debug mode to show backend, strategy, and memory_refs_count.
Allow overlay to be disabled for headless or automated runs.

should_capture: annotated frame snapshots at key events
a short replay log of event transitions
policy: Keep artifacts outside git by default if machine-specific or large.
Commit only small summaries/manifests if appropriate; otherwise keep them generated and documented.
Do not store private images in git.

tasks.title: Audit iteration-005 state and design live runtime integration
actions: Review current perception, memory, dialogue, and demo/runtime code paths.
Document where the live loop should integrate without breaking existing APIs.
Fix any obvious local-run documentation drift before adding the new runtime.
acceptance_criteria: A short architecture note is added to the report or docs describing the live integration points.
No unnecessary refactor of stable iteration-005 subsystems.

tasks.title: Implement frame source and live runner foundations
actions: Add webcam source support using OpenCV or equivalent local capture.
Add local video replay mode using the same frame-processing path.
Add a CLI runner script such as scripts/live_companion.py with clear flags/env integration.
acceptance_criteria: Local webcam mode can start and stop cleanly.
Local replay mode can process a short local video file without code changes.

tasks.title: Implement automatic session lifecycle management
actions: Start a session when presence criteria are met.
Pause on absence timeout.
Resume the prior session when the same user returns within the resume window, otherwise start a new session.
Trigger consolidation on end or long pause as appropriate.
acceptance_criteria: Arrival, pause, resume, and end transitions are visible in logs/artifacts.
Session handling works in replay and/or manual webcam tests.

tasks.title: Implement event engine and cooldown scheduler
actions: Detect meaningful transition events from live state.
Implement cooldowns and suppression rules.
Return explicit suppression reasons when an event does not trigger a response.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated identical events do not spam responses.
Cooldown state is inspectable in logs or debug state.

tasks.title: Wire proactive grounded responses into live mode
actions: Use the existing memory-grounded /respond path or equivalent internal call for proactive events.
Ensure recognized users receive memory-aware greetings when appropriate.
Ensure unknown users do not receive invented personalization.
acceptance_criteria: At least one live/replay scenario produces a memory-grounded greeting for a known user.
At least one unknown-user scenario produces a safe generic response or no proactive response.

tasks.title: Add live overlay and local UX
actions: Render local overlay with status, identity, body-state, and last response.
Support a headless mode where overlays are disabled but logs still run.
Optionally add a Gradio inspection path, but do not make it the only live path.
acceptance_criteria: A local user can see the system state change live or via replay.
Headless mode can still run verification and produce artifacts.

tasks.title: Add artifact logging and proof capture
actions: Log session transitions, events, responses, cooldown suppressions, and key snapshots.
Create a manifest and summary for live runs and verification runs.
Ensure artifact paths are configurable and documented.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts are generated for manual or replay verification.
A reviewer can audit what happened after a run from the artifact files alone.

tasks.title: Automated tests, manual verification, docs, report, commit, and push
actions: Add automated tests for session supervisor, event engine, cooldown logic, and live status data models.
Use replay/headless-friendly tests wherever possible.
Run lint and tests.
Perform manual local verification on webcam or local replay and store proof artifacts.
Update all required docs and project state files.
Write reports/iteration-006.md and reports/iteration-006.json.
Commit and push the branch.
acceptance_criteria: Manual verification results are reported honestly.
Artifacts are stored in the documented locations.

manual_verification_requirements.target_environment: local laptop/workstation preferred; replay mode allowed on headless or remote systems
must_add: a replay-friendly script mode for environments without webcam UI
artifact manifest and summary for verification_006

verification_matrix.requirement: Runner starts cleanly in webcam or replay mode and writes initial status/log files.
Recognized returning user triggers one memory-grounded greeting when cooldown allows.
Unknown user does not receive invented personalization; system stays generic or quiet.
Presence criteria trigger session start automatically without manual API calls.
Absence timeout pauses or ends session and logs transition.
Return within resume window resumes; otherwise a new session starts.
Repeated events do not create repeated responses inside cooldown windows.
After a configured quiet interval, one gentle companionship prompt may fire.
A stable engagement/posture change can trigger a check-in or is honestly suppressed with reason.
Overlay/debug state shows identity, posture, engagement, last event, and last response.
GET /v1/live/status returns current runtime state when active.
A live proactive response uses retrieved memory_refs and stores proof in artifacts.
Fresh or low-memory users do not trigger fabricated recall.
Any diagnosis-style user turn in live mode still yields safe redirect behavior.
Manifest, summary, event log, response log, and selected snapshots exist and are readable.
Replay mode exercises the same core pipeline and produces comparable artifacts.

must_have_automated_tests: known vs unknown proactive decision path
test_honesty_rules: Do not claim webcam mode works unless it was exercised on a real local machine, or honestly mark webcam-specific cases not_run and provide replay results.
Do not claim overlay rendering works unless a local or replay artifact proves it.
Keep automated tests and manual/replay verification clearly separated in the report.

honesty_rules: Do not state that live webcam behavior works unless it was exercised locally or clearly distinguish replay-only verification.
Do not fake push status, commit hashes, model outputs, screenshots, or artifact files.
If any event type is implemented but not verified, say so explicitly.
If scope had to be reduced, document exactly what was reduced and why.
definition_of_done: Architecture and core docs are updated and match the code.
A local live runner exists for webcam and/or replay mode.
Automatic session lifecycle works and is logged.
Event-driven proactive responses with cooldowns are implemented.
At least one memory-grounded live/replay response is verified.
Manual or replay verification results are reported honestly.
Iteration report exists in markdown and JSON.
